questions.q: Why did Jim and Hands have to wait before beaching the ship?
choices: The tide had not yet risen far enough
The wind had died completely
Hands was too weak to give orders
They were waiting for Silver's signal
questions.evidence: dared not beach her till the tide had flowed a good deal farther

questions.q: What did Hands first ask Jim to do with O'Brien's body?
choices: Heave it overboard
Bury it on shore
Carry it to the cabin
Cover it with a sail
questions.evidence: s'pose you was to heave him overboard

questions.q: What question did Hands ask Jim about O'Brien?
choices: Whether a dead man is dead for good or comes alive again
Whether O'Brien had any family
Whether O'Brien had hidden any gold
Whether O'Brien could read
questions.evidence: do you take it as a dead man is dead for good, or do he come alive again?

questions.q: Jim says Hands's request for wine "was a pretext." What is a pretext?
choices: A false reason given to hide the real one
A polite request
A medical treatment
A kind of strong drink
questions.evidence: The whole story was a pretext

questions.q: Why did Jim disbelieve Hands's request for wine?
choices: Hands hesitated strangely and would not meet Jim's eyes
There was no wine left on the ship
Hands had said he hated wine
Jim had seen Hands hide the brandy

questions.q: After going below noisily, what did Jim do next?
choices: Slipped off his shoes and secretly watched Hands from the fore companion
Searched the cabin for a pistol
Hid in the cellar until Hands fell asleep
Climbed out the cabin window
questions.evidence: popped my head out of the fore companion

questions.q: What did Jim see Hands take from a coil of rope?
choices: A short dirk stained with blood
A loaded pistol
A bottle of brandy
The treasure map
questions.evidence: a long knife, or rather a short dirk, discoloured to the hilt with blood

questions.q: Why did Jim believe Hands would not kill him right away?
choices: They both needed the schooner beached safely first
Hands was too weak to stand
Hands wanted Jim to find the treasure
Hands was afraid of Captain Smollett
questions.evidence: until that was done I considered that my life would certainly be spared

questions.q: What does Hands's speech about "thirty years" at sea show about his beliefs?
choices: He thinks striking first is best and that goodness never pays
He regrets becoming a pirate
He believes in mercy for enemies
He wants to retire to a farm
questions.evidence: Him as strikes first is my fancy; dead men don't bite

questions.q: What did Jim and Hands see at the southern end of North Inlet?
choices: An old wrecked ship covered in seaweed and flowering bushes
The pirates' campfire
Ben Gunn's cave
A second schooner at anchor
questions.evidence: we saw the wreck of a ship in the last stages of dilapidation

questions.q: How did Hands say they could get the ship off the beach later?
choices: Run a line to a pine and pull her off at high water
Wait for a storm to wash her free
Dig away the sand with shovels
Tow her with the ship's boats
questions.evidence: take a turn about one of them big pines

questions.q: What made Jim forget to keep watching Hands?
choices: The excitement of steering the ship to the shore
He fell asleep at the tiller
He was eating his dinner
He was reading the doctor's book
questions.evidence: The excitement of these last manoeuvres had somewhat interfered with the watch

questions.q: What saved Jim when Hands first charged at him with the dirk?
choices: The tiller swung and struck Hands across the chest
Jim shot him with a pistol
The ship struck the sand
Jim jumped into the sea
questions.evidence: it struck Hands across the chest and stopped him

questions.q: Why did Jim's pistol fail to fire the first time?
choices: The priming was wet with sea-water
It was not loaded at all
Hands had stolen the bullets
The trigger was broken
questions.evidence: the priming was useless with sea-water

questions.q: What happened when the HISPANIOLA struck the sand?
choices: The ship tipped over and both of them rolled into the scuppers
The mast broke and fell
Hands was thrown into the sea
The ship floated free again
questions.evidence: We were both of us capsized in a second

questions.q: Where did Jim escape to after the ship tipped over?
choices: Up the mizzen shrouds to the cross-trees
Down into the cabin
Onto the shore
Into the cellar

questions.q: How did Jim feel as Hands pretended to give up?
choices: Proud and pleased with himself
Terrified and in tears
Sorry for Hands
Bored and sleepy
questions.evidence: as conceited as a cock upon a wall

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: Hands secretly plots to kill Jim, and Jim survives his attack
Jim and Hands become loyal friends
Jim sails the ship back to Captain Smollett
Jim searches the ship for the treasure
questions.evidence: it was plain that I was meant to be the victim
